channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: Donegal and Derry share points as postponed McKenna Cup clash won't be re-fixed
item.description: This afternoon's postponed Dr McKenna Cup first round clash between Donegal and Derry will not be re-fixed.

item.title: Former Kildare captain Hyland retires from inter-county duty
item.description: Former Kildare senior captain David Hyland has announced his retirement from inter-county football.

item.title: St Brigid's edge out Scotstown to claim All-Ireland club SFC final spot against Dingle
item.description: St Brigid's booked their place in the All-Ireland club senior football championship final against Dingle thanks to a 1-16 to 1-12 victory over Scotstown before a 4,837 crowd at a freezing cold Kingspan Breffni this afternoon.

item.title: Sunday's club and inter-county results
item.description: See below for this afternoon's All-Ireland club senior football championship, Dr McKenna Cup, Connacht FBD FL, Kehoe Cup and Walsh Cup results...

item.title: Flanagan takes Granard reins
item.description: Pat Flanagan has been appointed as the new St Mary's, Granard senior football manager.

item.title: Brennan casts net far and wide in talent search
item.description: Ger Brennan has run the rule over in excess of 130 players since becoming Dublin senior football manager last autumn.

item.title: Laois hurling hero Dunphy calls it a day
item.description: Laois hurling star Willie Dunphy has brought the curtain down on his stellar 14-year inter-county career.

item.title: Dingle hoping to have O'Connor for final
item.description: Dingle manager Padraig Corcoran is hopeful that Aussie Rules star Mark O'Connor will be available for Sunday week's All-Ireland club SFC final against St Brigid's at Croke Park.

item.title: St Brigid's eye final redemption
item.description: Anthony Cunningham is hoping the memories of St Brigid's heartbreaking 2024 All-Ireland club SFC final loss to Glen will drive them to victory in this year's decider against Dingle.

item.title: Cats criticised for refusing to play Walsh Cup game
item.description: Westmeath GAA has issued a statement in which it hits out at Kilkenny for their "clear refusal to play a properly scheduled and authorised fixture".
